name: NetEsp32
description: ESP32-only adapters for NetEngine: EspWifiPort (WiFi + ESPmDNS), AsyncMqttTransport (AsyncMqttClient), EspOtaPlatform (esp_ota_ops + the strong verifyRollbackLater() override), WebServerHost (AsyncWebServer + AdminAuth + ElegantOTA + setup/Wi-Fi/version endpoints), EspotaService and the ConnectivityServices facade.
